description:
A window of bars. Name exactly what you want, one of: `series` = comma-separated names (at most 200) from
tilla_inventory, or a pattern like 'eurusd_*' / '*_close'; or `markets` + `fields` ('eurusd,gbpusd' + 'close' ->
eurusd_close, gbpusd_close). Stocks, ETFs and coins by symbol (AAPL, BTC) are bars: GET /v1/<tier>/bars/<lane>
?kind=stocks|coins&markets=... (see tilla_markets). layer = raw | node; lane = 1min, 5min, hour,
daily, ... start/end = 'YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM[:SS]]' UTC inclusive, or period = 30d 2m 6m 1y all; no start = the
newest bars. limit <= 50000. When `more` is true, call again with start = `next_start`. Needs your API key (hosted: the X-API-Key header; local: TILLA_API_KEY).
name: tilla_window
title: Bars in a time range
